reviewMethod: Every assigned main DTC row read in primary GM PDF text extraction. Continuations reviewed where relevant. Original monitor explanations and diagnostic inferences authored individually; common applicability footer only. No model or engine inferred from file-level application matrix.

needsReview.issue: Maximum SQP rows contain copied minimum-authority wording. Maximum heading, greater-than comparison and maximum calibration identifier agree. Articles explain upper boundary but retain conflict and needs-review status.
Strategy prose says low despite circuit-high heading and greater-than-99-percent criterion. Article explicitly discloses conflict.
Prose says feedback above threshold while explicit threshold compares battery minus feedback with calibrated maximum. Article explains differential expression without inventing a numeric limit.
Narrative says insufficient movement after soak, but threshold column uses greater-than for absolute change. Article gives supported response-monitor concept without publishing an assumed inequality.
Analog criterion is printed below zero ohms and cannot be used as a credible physical resistance instruction. Digital low-temperature criterion and enable logic explained; analog needs verification.
Conditional Smart VSB wording says present TRUE while adjacent value is FALSE. Article limits this to configuration-dependent ignition-delay context and requires exact service definition.
Heading and code identify cylinder 5, narrative says glow plug 4. Article discloses conflict and requires vehicle-specific cylinder identification.

limitedOrExcludedEvidence.note: Additional gm-2025-07a-2 rows were read but not used for numeric criteria or model claims. Articles cite only 25OBDG04B, avoiding unresolved file-to-application join and conflicting implementations. P05D3 additional row includes impossible range placeholders; those values are excluded.
Dictionary sensor-letter labels differ from primary GM channel names. Articles explicitly explain the discrepancy without assigning physical locations.
Extracted numeric threshold units are unclear. Articles explain supported monitor mechanisms and enabling conditions without inventing units.
Run/crank enable column lists 11 V without clear inequality. Articles explicitly avoid inventing direction.
Article explicitly scoped to regeneration-based close-coupled diesel oxidation-catalyst monitor portion. Other referenced rich-combustion variant is not generalized.
Dynamic limit logic described from prose; corrupted extracted exponent is not reproduced or reconstructed as a calibration formula.
